```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F)
```

```{r prep data - age differences in color, echo = FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(viridis)

here::i_am("R_scripts/03_Age_color_models.Rmd")

avg_img <- read.csv(here("data/BTBW_whole_specimen_Image_Analysis_measurements_allpop_avgimg_wide.csv"))

## select only brightness for ASY males
age <- avg_img %>% 
  filter(Age == "ASY" | Age == "SY")

```

# Crown
```{r crown, echo=F}

t <- t.test(lumMean_c ~ Age, data = age, na.action = "na.omit")
pval <- t$p.value
# Calculate means and confidence intervals
summary_stats <- age %>%
  group_by(Age) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(lumMean_c, na.rm = T),
    stdev = sd(lumMean_c, na.rm = T)
  )

# Correct usage of sprintf to create the annotation text with standard deviation
text_annotation <- sprintf("ASY: %.3f ± %.3f, SY: %.3f ± %.3f, p-value: %.3f", summary_stats$mean[1], summary_stats$stdev[1], summary_stats$mean[2], summary_stats$stdev[2],pval)

ggplot(data = age, aes(y = lumMean_c, x = Age)) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Crown luminance") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = text_annotation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, size = 5, color = "blue")+
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.75,
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

```

# make a table of results
```{r age table, echo=F, results="asis"}

# One row per trait: sample size, mean (SD) for each age class, and the Welch
# two-sample t-test (R's default t.test, which does not assume equal variances,
# so df are not whole numbers)
traits <- c(lumMean_c  = "Crown luminance",
            lumMean_o  = "Covert luminance",
            lumMean_m  = "Mantle luminance",
            lumMean_t  = "Throat luminance",
            lumMean_w  = "Wing spot luminance",
            area_mm2_w = "Wing spot area (mm²)")

source(here("R_scripts/table_helpers.R"))

# tidy results: numbers kept as numbers, full precision (readable table below)
age_table <- list()
for (var in names(traits)) {
  asy_values <- na.omit(age[[var]][age$Age == "ASY"])
  sy_values  <- na.omit(age[[var]][age$Age == "SY"])
  test <- t.test(asy_values, sy_values)

  age_table[[var]] <- data.frame(
    Trait = var,
    ASY_n = length(asy_values), ASY_mean = mean(asy_values), ASY_SD = sd(asy_values),
    SY_n = length(sy_values),   SY_mean = mean(sy_values),   SY_SD = sd(sy_values),
    t = unname(test$statistic), df = unname(test$parameter), p = test$p.value)
}
age_table <- bind_rows(age_table)
write.csv(age_table, here("results/Age_color_models_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

table_note <- paste("Note: Welch two-sample t-tests comparing after-second-year (ASY) and",
                    "second-year (SY) males; t > 0 means ASY is higher. Luminance = mean",
                    "double-cone catch of the patch; n = birds with a measurement for that patch.")
writeLines(table_note, here("results/Age_color_models_table_note.txt"))

# readable table: mean (SD) with 3 and 2 significant figures, ASY and SY under spanners
age_display <- age_table %>%
  transmute(Trait = traits[Trait],
            ASY_n, `ASY mean (SD)` = paste0(fmt_num(ASY_mean, 3), " (", fmt_num(ASY_SD, 2), ")"),
            SY_n,  `SY mean (SD)`  = paste0(fmt_num(SY_mean, 3), " (", fmt_num(SY_SD, 2), ")"),
            t = sprintf("%.2f", t), df = sprintf("%.1f", df), p = fmt_p(p))

print(knitr::kable(age_display, caption = "Plumage traits by age class", row.names = FALSE,
                   col.names = c("Trait", "ASY n", "ASY mean (SD)", "SY n", "SY mean (SD)", "t", "df", "p")))
cat("\n", table_note, "\n")

save_table(
  age_display %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(title = "Plumage traits by age class") %>%
    tab_spanner("ASY", columns = c(ASY_n, `ASY mean (SD)`)) %>%
    tab_spanner("SY", columns = c(SY_n, `SY mean (SD)`)) %>%
    tab_spanner("Welch t-test", columns = c(t, df, p)) %>%
    cols_label(ASY_n = "n", `ASY mean (SD)` = "Mean (SD)", SY_n = "n", `SY mean (SD)` = "Mean (SD)") %>%
    tab_source_note(sub("^Note: ", "", table_note)) %>%
    style_table(),
  "Age_color_models_table")

```
